name: Sun-Scaled Temple-Host
identity: Saurian temple-warriors, scaleling skirmishers and primeval thunder-lizards. Every saurian and beast bites as well as strikes, and they become crueller against anything already bleeding.

rules.name: Predatory Jaws · Cold-Blooded
rules.description: Saurian Class 1–2 units and every Class 3–5 beast carry Predatory jaws ([EXTRA ATTACKS], [SHREDDING WOUNDS]). Cold-Blooded: melee Hit rolls of 5+ are critical against enemy units that are below Starting Strength or damaged, and Sun-Scaled units ignore negative modifiers to their melee Hit rolls.

rules.name: Gamble — Apex Savagery
rules.description: When a unit is selected to Fight: +1 Damage on its melee weapons this activation, but it has −1 ARM until it next activates. (Risk: exposure (durability).)

detachments.name: Sunclaw Hunt
detachments.playstyle: Beasts and raptors running down the wounded.

rules.name: Rampage
rules.description: Monstrous Rampage applies to all Class 4–5 Sun-Scaled units; Class 2–5 units get +1″ to Charge rolls against units below Starting Strength.

enhancements.name: Blood-Crest
enhancements.description: **Scar-Veteran Old-Blood** only. +1 Damage on a round he charged.

stratagems.name: Savage Bite
stratagems.turn: A unit is selected to Fight

stratagems.name: Scent of Prey
stratagems.effect: One friendly unit within 12″ makes a 3″ move toward it.

stratagems.name: Primal Roar
stratagems.turn: A Class 4–5 unit ends a Charge
stratagems.effect: Engaged enemy units are Rattled on a 4+.

detachments.name: Starborne Prophecy
detachments.playstyle: The plan of the elders: a cosmic asterism shapes the battle.

rules.name: Asterisms
rules.description: At deployment pick 1; in Round 3 pick a second (both active). Great Drake (+1 to Wound in melee on a round the unit charged) · Hunter's Steed (+2″ MOV) · Sage's Staff (+1 ARM to 3+ cap against ranged attacks).

enhancements.name: Starstone Cartouche
enhancements.description: **Sun-Priest Astromancer** only. Pick the second asterism in Round 2.

enhancements.name: Comet-Fragment Blade
enhancements.description: **Star-Sage Elder** only. The attached unit has WARD 5+.

stratagems.name: Celestial Alignment
stratagems.effect: One unit benefits from all three asterisms until the End of Round.

stratagems.name: Predestined Strike
stratagems.turn: A unit is selected to Shoot or Fight

stratagems.name: Sky-Fire Comet
stratagems.effect: An enemy unit within 24″ of a Leader suffers D6 Fatal Wounds on a 3+.

detachments.name: Coalesced Scales
detachments.playstyle: Armoured saurians and shell-beasts holding the temple.

rules.name: Scaly Skin
rules.description: Saurian Class 2 units and Class 4–5 beasts reduce incoming PEN by 1 (min 0).

stratagems.name: Unbreakable Line
stratagems.turn: A unit within 3″ of an objective is charged
stratagems.effect: It is not Rattled; +1 to Wound on its Retaliation Strike.

stratagems.name: Temple Stand
stratagems.effect: One unit gets [SECURED] until the End of Round.
